name: Amancio Ortega
notes: Forbes profile (as of Sep 27, 2026): $135.4B, #11 in the world, citizenship Spain, source of wealth Zara (self-made); the Forbes profile shows no Philanthropy Score field for Ortega (it lists Source of Wealth, Residence, Citizenship only), so score is null. Giving Pledge: Ortega does not appear on the official pledger-list page (checked Sep 27, 2026). Foundation: Fundación Amancio Ortega (La Coruña, Spain; created 2001) is a Spanish foundation governed by Galician Law 12/2006 and Spanish Law 50/2002; it does not file a US Form 990-PF, so EIN, 5% payout test and related-party fields are not applicable (null). Its own 'Foundation in Figures' page (primary) reports: Investment in projects 2025 = EUR 99.6M total (EUR 98.8M social investment in own projects and financing to other institutions: education 12.5, social welfare 86.3; structural costs 0.85). Executed 2021-2025: EUR 514M total (education 47, social welfare 464, structural 2.5); committed 2026-2030: EUR 511M. Income 2025: EUR 83M (founder contributions 66, financial income 17); 2021-2025: EUR 1,049M (founder contributions 1,021, financial income 27). Note latestGrantsMillions is in EUR, not USD, and is 'investment in projects' rather than a grants line. Total assets were not shown on the figures page; the audited annual accounts PDF (https://www.faortega.org/documents/67/FUNDACION_AMANCIO_ORTEGA_Informe_AuditoriaCCAA_2025.pdf) is linked but was not read. Programs named are in Spain and Portugal (proton therapy programs in both national health systems) but no per-country grant table was seen, hence publishesGrantsByCountry null. Web-search summary (needs-check, faortega.org Spanish figures page and press): 2024 project investment EUR 207.6M (196.2 social welfare, 10.9 education), a EUR 100M DANA flood-relief fund in 2024, and a EUR 765M founder contribution in 2024. Political 2024 cycle: not applicable (Spanish citizen; US federal giving would be prohibited); nothing seen. Lifetime giving: no consolidated figure seen.
